dct_description_sm: Data was collected in order to better inform the community of Pond Inlet with regards to the risk associated with the consumptions of marine wildlife and fishes that represents the bulk country used locally. This database provides data in different areas that are used traditionnally for hunting but that had never been sampled before. The data will be used by local organization such as the Mittimatalik Hunters and Trappers Organization for local planning, and by regional organization such as the Nunavut Research Institute and the Government of Nunavut's Health Department for public messaging. This study is community-driven and lead by a local researcher from Pond Inlet.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Traditional food
dct_title_s: Mercury and trace metals concentrations in Arctic char and Ringed seal from the Eclipse Sound near Pond Inlet, Nunavut (2016-2017)
